headline: Analysts Warn Big Tech Share Issuance Could Dilute Investor Ownership
summary: Big Tech hyperscalers may face temptations to issue more shares as interest rates rise and equity markets hold up, potentially harming current shareholders.
why: Equity dilution increases share supply, which can reduce earnings per share and weigh on long-term shareholder returns.

impacts.name: Technology
impacts.why: Potential share issuance by major technology firms could dilute existing equity holdings.
